pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients and high angularity. Patch size is heterogeneous, exhibiting a reduction in spatial area from the cervical region toward the ventral-posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is uniform across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the superior neck margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright yellow out-of-focus artifacts are present in the foreground, partially occluding the lower posterior segment of the subject.
